title: Send an action goal
description: Ask /drive_distance_server to move one metre and receive its final result. The server controls the actual simulated robot.
steps: Use action list, action type /drive_distance and interface show ros2learn_interfaces/action/DriveDistance.
Send DriveDistance.Goal with distance = 1.0.
When accepted, request get_result_async and inspect result.success and result.final_distance.
hints: DriveDistance is our educational custom interface, not a standard ROS action.
send_goal_async resolves to a goal handle, not directly to the final result.
In the accepted callback: future.result().get_result_async().add_done_callback(on_result).

es.title: Enviar un objetivo de acción
es.description: Pide a /drive_distance_server que avance un metro y recibe el resultado. El servidor mueve el robot simulado.
steps: Usa ros2 action list, ros2 action type /drive_distance y ros2 interface show ros2learn_interfaces/action/DriveDistance.
Envía DriveDistance.Goal con distance = 1.0.
Tras aceptar el objetivo, usa get_result_async e inspecciona result.success y result.final_distance.
hints: DriveDistance es una interfaz educativa propia, no una acción ROS estándar.
send_goal_async devuelve un manejador del objetivo, no el resultado final.
En el callback de aceptación: future.result().get_result_async().add_done_callback(on_result).
